name: Lifeline (phone and internet discount)
valueBasis: A flat monthly discount on phone or internet service, times twelve.

criteria.instructions: Does any member of this household receive SNAP?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does anyone in your household get SNAP or food stamps?
criteria.note: Any one qualifying programme settles Lifeline on its own.

criteria.instructions: Does any member of this household receive Medicaid?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does anyone in your household have Medicaid?

criteria.instructions: Does any member of this household receive Supplemental Security Income? SSI is not the same as Social Security retirement or disability insurance.
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does anyone in your household get SSI?
criteria.note: The same answer settles SNAP categorical eligibility, which is why this criterion is worth more than the others when it is uncertain.

criteria.instructions: Does any member receive Federal Public Housing Assistance, including a Section 8 voucher or residence in public housing?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Do you live in public housing or use a Section 8 voucher?

criteria.instructions: Does any member receive the Veterans Pension or Survivors Pension benefit? This is the needs-based pension, not disability compensation or the GI Bill.
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does anyone here get a Veterans Pension or Survivors Pension?

criteria.instructions: Does this household live on federally recognised Tribal lands?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Do you live on Tribal lands?
criteria.note: Raises the monthly benefit and adds four qualifying programmes.

criteria.instructions: Does any member receive one of these Tribal programmes?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does anyone here get Bureau of Indian Affairs General Assistance, Tribal TANF, Tribal Head Start, or food from FDPIR?

criteria.bia_general_assistance: Bureau of Indian Affairs General Assistance
criteria.tribal_head_start: Tribal Head Start, having met the income standard
criteria.fdpir: Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations

criteria.instructions: Does anyone at this address already receive a Lifeline benefit?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Does anyone at your address already get a Lifeline discount?
criteria.note: One benefit per household, where a household is people at one address who share income and expenses.

verdict: receives_snap OR receives_medicaid OR receives_ssi OR receives_fpha OR receives_veterans_pension OR tribal_programs OR income_test
